description:
Project: website — lead generation page

Business: Services Piscine Express — a Quebec-based business that captures leads for reputable swimming pool opening, closing, and maintenance services, then sells these leads to actual service companies.

Goal: Capture leads from residential pool owners, allowing them to select pre-listed services, upload photos of their pool/backyard, and request a call within 24 hours with a booking date and timeslot.

Target audience: Residential pool owners.

Key features:
- Lead capture form for residential pool owners.
- Pre-listed services for pool opening, closing, and maintenance.
- Option to upload pictures of their pool/backyard during submission.
- Functionality for users to select a booking date and timeslot for a call.
- A separate link for service companies to sign up.

Design & brand:
- Colors: Beige and a bit of blue for water representation/pool.
- Mood: Reliable and quick turnaround.
- Signature (what the site is remembered by): The cool process of requesting a call, including booking a date and timeslot on the same day.
- First impression / photos & logo: No existing photos or logo; the studio will create the look.

Integrations & extras: The homepage should not explicitly advertise to service companies, only to end pool users.

designManifest.copyVoice: Concierge québécois direct et attentionné; vouvoiement français et anglais intégral; rappel souhaité plutôt qu’intervention réservée.

pages: Accueil et demande en trois étapes

designManifest.heroThesis: Votre piscine. Votre heure de rappel. Le billet commence volontairement vide et ne montre que les choix réellement faits.
designManifest.iconDirection: Billet cobalt à deux encoches et deux traits blancs sur carré beige, sans lettres, lisible à petite taille.
designManifest.signatureMove: Un seul billet beige bordé de cobalt accompagne les trois étapes, devient repliable sur mobile et se transforme en confirmation de demande, jamais en réservation de travaux.
designManifest.summary: Un billet de rappel se remplit au rythme d’une demande courte, dans un cadre beige calme ponctué de bleu piscine.
designManifest.typography: Sora SemiBold pour le mot-symbole, les titres et les dates; Source Sans 3 Regular/SemiBold pour les textes et les formulaires; chiffres tabulaires pour les heures.

directions.pitch: Avec ce billet bleu qui se remplit sous leurs yeux, vos clients savent exactement quelle demande ils envoient et quand ils souhaitent être rappelés, tout en reconnaissant votre marque dès la première visite.
Cette direction donne à votre nom Express une preuve concrète : vos clients voient les plages proposées, choisissent la leur et comprennent le parcours sans devoir chercher comment vous joindre.
En montrant une cour qui ressemble à celle de vos clients et un agenda immédiatement utilisable, cette direction rend votre service accueillant sans ralentir leur demande de rappel.

promptHistory.changeNotes:
I implemented the supplied Le billet bleu identity, including bilingual draft preservation, authenticated request history, private photo handling, and a complete admin backend. Callback windows start empty and must be published by the owner; the form honestly offers an unscheduled request until real windows exist. I kept exactly the three requested services and did not fabricate customer submissions, partner applications, or availability. Private photo delivery follows Cloudinary’s authenticated, expiring-access approach, and the privacy copy distinguishes commercial disclosure from marketing consent. ([cloudinary.com](https://cloudinary.com/documentation/control_access_to_media?utm_source=openai))

Rebuilt administration around operational metrics, actionable module cards, intake status, callback availability and direct links to individual records.,Added responsive CRUD workspaces with contextual status filters, search, pagination, accessible edit dialogs, unsaved-change protection and clearer save/delete feedback.,Replaced service-ID JSON editing with catalogue checkboxes; retained historical service names, protected technical ownership fields and added consent evidence validation.,Added Quebec-time date pickers with explicit offsets, public-image previews and inline AI generation tools, plus authorized private-photo previews within lead records.,Added typed intake/contact settings while retaining advanced key editing and existing platform administration APIs.,Improved contrast, mobile navigation, keyboard focus, CTA fallbacks and self-contained typography; preserved bilingual content hooks and all existing image placeholders.,Preserved private-photo retention and lead submission flows; prevented seed updates from overwriting saved images, hardened embedded JSON, and added bilingual SEO/social metadata.

The narrow-screen request flow now uses comfortable single-column service choices, stacked step labels, balanced action grids, and scroll offsets that account for the persistent callback ticket. The mobile ticket remains sticky with a capped, internally scrolling expanded body, while breakpoint synchronization prevents it from becoming inaccessible after resizing. Callback choices now retain keyboard focus across redraws and use stable geometry in selected states, and the hero typography has been refined for clearer reading hierarchy.
